result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers give pasteable rem values, sensible desktop-to-mobile h1 scaling and correct heading and body line-heights. Answer A never limits the line length, so it fails the 60-75 character measure entirely. Answer B caps paragraphs, list items and captions at 65ch, but it applies the cap per element rather than to the article column. B also hardcodes line-heights instead of making them custom properties, and only sets a code line-height on pre. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers give sound, pasteable scales with suitable body sizes and heading line-heights, and both reduce the h1 properly on mobile. Answer B never caps the line length, so it misses the 60-75 character measure, while Answer A sets 65ch on paragraphs and list items. B handles code and captions slightly better, but A's line-length cap is the bigger readability win.
